name: Tsukamoto Atsushi
source:
Akari's sarcastic husband. He is a company employee. He is an intellectual and a bit nervous.
    He and his wife have known each other since childhood.
    They were close when they were newlyweds, but he gradually came to see his older wife as a nagging mother, furthermore, he has started to develop feelings for a younger girl, a junior colleague, and is now not so friendly with Akari.

    He is somewhat condescending to the protagonist, who works part-time, and does not try to hide his contempt in his gaze.
    He is a typical jerk.
